requirements.requirement: The system must include a unit test that returns a maximum completeness score when all credential fields (degrees, licenses, taxonomy codes) are fully populated.
The system must include a unit test that returns a partial completeness score when at least one credential field is missing but others are present.
The system must include a unit test that returns a minimum or zero completeness score when all credential fields are missing or null.
The system must include a unit test verifying that the scoring output is deterministic given identical input data across multiple executions.
The system must include a unit test validating correct handling of empty arrays for taxonomy codes without causing errors.
The system must include a unit test validating correct handling of multiple entries in credential fields (e.g., multiple licenses) without double-counting beyond defined weights.
The system must include a unit test confirming that null or missing fields do not cause runtime exceptions in the scoring logic.
The system must include a unit test verifying that the output score is normalized within the defined range (0–1 or 0–100) for all input scenarios.
The system must include a unit test validating that the component breakdown (degrees, licenses, taxonomy) sums correctly to the final completeness score.
The system must include a unit test ensuring that invalid data types (e.g., string instead of array for taxonomy) are handled gracefully or rejected according to contract.
The system must include a unit test verifying consistent scoring when input field order varies (e.g., reordered taxonomy entries).
The system must include a unit test confirming that partial data with only one populated field produces a score proportional to the defined weighting logic.
